We crowd-sourced a dataset of two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) image triplets using Amazon MTurk. Five unique workers were shown three generated images from the same prompt—a reference image, image A, and image B—and instructed to pick whether A or B resembled the reference more.
guideline: Workers judged similarity on a scale from 'not similar at all' (rating 1) to 'the same' (5), later merged into four categories: none, low, medium, high similarity.
Workers were asked to select the image most similar to a reference (2AFC) and to rate similarity between image pairs on a 1‑5 scale (later collapsed to four categories: high, medium, low, none).
